about_the_game:
Experience the action-packed story of Circuit Thunder®. Circuit Thunder® is a 2D-platformer, action-adventure RPG where you follow the legendary Electrex Bolt® and master electrifying abilities of light, ultimately harnessing lightning as your weapon. Traverse through novel lands, battle mysterious enemies, and strategically learn new defensive and offensive abilities. 

Begin your journey with the first book, Circuit Thunder®: Hypcampex® 

BOOK I : HYPCAMPEX®

Set within Planet Photonus, you will embark on a journey as the legendary Electrex Bolt® to acquire the artifact of the Hypcampex® and stop the Avengers of Light, the Lavengers, from destroying the planet. With vibrant environments, pestering enemies, and innovative maps, you will be able to put your skills to the test and brave the war against the Lavengers. Will Electrex Bolt® succeed? 

SAVE PLANET PHOTONUS FROM ANARCHY

Destroy the drone waves deployed by the Lavengers and best their tactics. The trials and puzzles that lie ahead will not be easy feats. It will take the most omnipotent of prowess.

FIGHT THROUGH SPACE

Battle through space on the BOLT Voyager V3 and show the Lavengers that Electrex Bolt® is the best pilot within the galaxy.

MASTER THE LIGHT

Does Electrex Bolt® have what it takes to master the light and revive those whom he has lost?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04 and Newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.1 ghz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2nd Generation Intel Core HD Graphics (2000/3000), 512MB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Clear cache for best performance. Utilize SSD for faster performance. This game contains flashes and visual effects that could trigger seizures. Please consult with your doctor before playing if you are prone to seizures or epilepsy. STEAM DECK: To play on Steam Deck, select the game > settings > properties > compatibility > force use + Proton 9.0. Next, select the Deck right menu > Performance > Use per-game profile > Disable Frame Limit
